text: Overdose Warnings: Taking more than the recommended dose (overdose) can cause serious health problems, including liver damage. adults and children 12 years of age and older: take 2 teaspoonfuls (10 mL) every 6 hours; do not exceed 8 teaspoonfuls (40 mL) in 24 hours not recommended for children under the age of 12: this adult strength product will provide more than the recommended dose (overdose), and may cause liver damage
